# topic

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.filters.topic`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(topics: Union[int, List[int]] = None): ...
```

## Documentation

Filter messages coming from one or more topics.
You can use [set bound methods](https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#set) to manipulate the
topics container.
### Parameters

- **`topics`** (`int` | `list`)
  Pass one or more topic ids to filter messages in specific topics.
  Pass 1 for general topic.
  Defaults to None (no topics).
